conviction_note: The print most likely adds a cut to the full-year plan. If H1 operating profit lands near ¥3.0bn, the ¥5.52bn FY plan needs H2 up about 30% YoY while the plan itself assumes H2 down 5%. Against that, the stock already trades at PER 7.65 / PBR 0.76, the low end of its six-year range; September same-store sales were the best since May; and the H1 miss is visible to anyone who reads the 月次. The findings sum to -1.2, and the scaled number (p_up 43 x abs 4.5 = -0.63) is smaller because rule 1 pulls p_up toward 50 for a miss that is already visible.
bar: Company H1 plan (unchanged at Q1: 'no change to the forecast announced on 2026-04-06'): H1 sales ¥92,580m, OP ¥3,800m, ordinary ¥3,790m; FY OP ¥5,520m. Source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260706/140120260703587374.pdf . No analyst consensus exists: IFIS shows rating '--', no target and no analyst forecast (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report_top&bcode=7679), and 四季報 is paywalled. print_vs_bar is measured on H1 operating profit. My estimate is about ¥3.0bn (range 2.75-3.25bn) against ¥3.8bn. On revenue the gap is about -3% (¥89.7bn against ¥92.6bn).
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per the baseline). 信用倍率 is 30.43 in the baseline. irbank's last weekly print (2026-07-17) shows 129,700 shares long against 10,300 short, a ratio of 12.59 (https://irbank.net/7679/margin). The margin long is crowded relative to the short side but small in absolute terms: about 0.7% of shares and about 2 days of volume. Fidelity is a disclosed seller (9.96% -> 9.13% by 2026-09-15). There is no squeeze fuel. The run-up is -2.97% over 20 days and -3.99% over 5, and the stock is near its 2026 low of ¥1,570. No options, so no skew.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) sales slowed sharply. Same-store sales ran 96.8/98.9/101.9 against 103.8-106.3 in Q1, and all-store sales ran 102.9/104.9/107.5 against about 111.5. Q1 SG&A grew 15.0% on 11.7% sales growth. Together these put H1 OP near ¥2.75-3.25bn against the ¥3.8bn H1 plan, which needed Q2 OP up about 20.6% YoY on the prior year's ¥1,966m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 (2026-07-06): OP -5.1%, progress 37.6% against a 5-year average of 44.1% (kabutan); stock -4.61% the next session. H1 FY26 (2025-10-06), on plan at 59.1% progress: -1.34%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. The 月次 are public monthly and the Q1 progress shortfall was printed by kabutan in July. Thin coverage (no analysts on IFIS) means nobody has published the profit arithmetic, so the size of the miss in yen is not in a headline until 15:30 today. The stock is down from ¥1,715 before Q1 to ¥1,560, which looks like a miss already being sold.
findings.independence: The Q1 tanshin cost structure (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260706/140120260703587374.pdf: SG&A ¥8,184m against ¥7,117m) and the prior-year H1 base (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251006/140120251006568717.pdf) are separate documents. All are inputs to one estimate.

findings.finding: If H1 lands near ¥3.0bn OP, the FY OP plan of ¥5.52bn (+4.4%) needs H2 OP of about ¥2.5bn, against ¥1.815bn last year and the plan's own implied ¥1.72bn. A full-year cut, probably to 'one-turn' profit decline (一転減益), is likely with this release. Last fiscal year the company cut FY OP by 10% together with its Q3 results, and it has revised at an H1 print before (2023-10-05).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-01-06 FY cut released with Q3 (OP ¥5,750m -> ¥5,155m, 一転減益): -4.15% the next session; kabutan/minkabu ran '大幅反落'. 2023-10-05 a revision came with H1 (direction not confirmed): +4.21%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. PER 7.65 on the company's EPS of ¥207 implies the market already doubts the plan. But a cut has not been announced: the company called Q1 'broadly on plan' and left both forecasts unchanged. On this name the cut itself is the headline the retail register sells, as the January 2026 cut shows. If it were fully priced, the January cut would not have produced a -4% session at a then-PER of about 10.
findings.independence: The Q1 tanshin forecast note says Q1 was '概ね計画通り', which is why H1 was back-loaded into Q2 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260706/140120260703587374.pdf). irbank's disclosure list shows the 2023-10-05 H1 revision and the 2026-01-06 revision (https://irbank.net/7679). This rests on the same Q2 weakness as finding 1: it is the forward consequence of that weakness, not a second count of it.

findings.finding: September same-store sales were +3.1% (customers -0.4%, spend +3.5%) and all-store sales +8.5%, the strongest month since May. This gives management an H2 recovery story to set against the H1 miss. The English version is dated Oct 5 and appeared on kabutan at 10:05 JST. The Japanese 月次 normally goes out at 15:30 with the results.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The August 月次 (same-store sales +1.9%, first positive in three months) produced +0.61% the next session and three straight up days (kabutan 2026-09-07). The July 月次 produced +1.06%.
findings.why_not_priced: Only the English translation is out, since 10:05 today, and the stock is down about 0.4% from the seal (¥1,560 against ¥1,566). The Japanese retail register normally reads it in the 15:30 batch, so most of its read lands in the window together with the H1 numbers.
findings.independence: The August 月次 shows the turn began in August (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260904/140120260903531138.pdf). This is the same company series.

findings.finding: A disclosed institutional seller is still distributing. Fidelity and its joint holders fell from 10.0% to 9.96% by 2026-07-15 and from 9.96% to 9.13% (1,965,638 -> 1,802,738 shares) by 2026-09-15, with FMR UK cutting from 6.47% to 5.13%. Retail margin longs are 12-30x the margin shorts.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Five consecutive post-print sessions were negative (2025-07-04 -5.0, 2025-10-06 -1.34, 2026-01-06 -4.15, 2026-04-06 -3.65, 2026-07-06 -4.61), computed from Yahoo daily closes.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced as flow: the seller has been in the tape for months. What matters at the print is that a seller of about 163k shares in two months, against about 70k shares of daily volume, is still there to meet any bounce. If the seller were spent, the 5-day run-up would not be -4% into the print.
findings.independence: Margin balances (https://irbank.net/7679/margin) and the baseline 信用倍率 of 30.43 are a different source, pointing the same way.

findings.finding: The stock trades at PER 7.65 (forecast) and PBR 0.76 at ¥1,586 (2026-10-02), the bottom of its 2020-2026 ranges (7.6-19.68x and 0.76-2.48x), and near the 2026 low of ¥1,570. A FY cut to about EPS ¥175 still leaves it under 9x, so the release is a candidate for 悪材料出尽くし (the bad news is out).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The April 2025 FY print came at a then-low of ¥1,636 and rose +8.19% (Yahoo closes 2025-04-07 -> 04-08); that is the only large positive reaction in the last eight.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a statement about what is priced, not an unpriced fact, so it is sized as a partial offset to finding 2. It is what a 'cut is already in the price' outcome would look like.
findings.independence: IFIS shows PER 7.7 and no analyst coverage (https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report_top&bcode=7679).

outside_window.finding: Q3 (Sep-Nov) recovery, if the September +3.1% same-store sales trend holds, would show up in the January 2027 Q3 print and the monthly reports from November.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: a FY cut is likely with this release; nothing was pre-filed and there is no 四季報/IFIS number to compare against. Returns: none expected, since there is no interim dividend and no history of buybacks at prints. New-year guide: not applicable (H1). Quarter vs its own 進捗率: Q1 was 37.6% against a 5-year average of 44.1%; H1 progress against FY was 59.1% last year (5-year average 60.7%), and my H1 estimate of about ¥3.0bn is about 54% of the FY plan.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Q1 gross margin compression, read from a scratch text that turned out to be another issuer's (壱番屋 7630) tanshin
rejected_candidates.detail: Yakuodo's own Q1 P&L shows gross margin flat (21.83% against 21.88%). The pressure is in SG&A, so no gross-margin finding was filed.

baseline_tension: The findings lean negative like the positioning lean (-0.59, mostly margin overhang) and the -3% run-up, so the negative half mostly agrees with what is priced. The strongest positive the release could carry is a HELD FY forecast backed by the September recovery (+3.1% same-store sales). I looked for buybacks and dividend changes and found no precedent at H1 prints. A hold would be a relief rally from PBR 0.76, which is why p_up sits at 43 and not lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 or 進捗率): the visible H1-miss finding moved from -0.7 to -0.3 and p_up from 40 to 43. The FY-cut finding was left at -1.5 because a cut is something the release ADDS, which rule 1 exempts.

Rule 2 (check the sign): wrote the strongest positive (a held forecast plus the September recovery) into baseline_tension. I had already looked for returns, so the positive findings were left unchanged.
Open question 4 (a 5-day run-in as a signal): not used; the -4% 5-day run-up was not sized as its own finding.
